title: Fix Reflection 2.0 infinite repeat loop on oldest 10 memories, missing embeddings/closeness, unvalidated rel: handles, and tag collisions

sections.what: Fix five Reflection 2.0 defects: candidate selection looping infinitely over the first 10 depth-0 memories every 5 turns, unembedded reflection records and uninitialized legacy insights, omitted 'closeness' relationship dimension, unvalidated rel:<who> tags, and _sanitizeTags stripping conceptual tags that collide with item/area names.
sections.why: AgentMemory.reflect() (static/js/agent/memory-manager.ts lines 43-46) always takes the first 10 memories where reflection_depth < 1, and creating a depth-1 reflection never marks the depth-0 sources as already reflected (while routes/memories.py lines 890-895 only guard against depth >= 1 inputs). Every 5 turns, the exact same oldest 10 memories get re-reflected into duplicate beliefs while entries 11+ starve. Generated reflections also skip _embedAndStoreVector (all keep embedding=None), legacy string insights skip ensure_dynamics and reflection_depth=1 (lines 870-883), prompt line 59 omits 'closeness', /reflect writes raw unvalidated 'rel:' + who strings, and _sanitizeTags strips conceptual tags matching any graph node name.
sections.how:
1. Update AgentMemory.reflect() (static/js/agent/memory-manager.ts lines 41-46) and routes/memories.py (/memories/reflect) to exclude candidate memories whose IDs already appear in an existing depth >= 1 reflection's source_memory_ids (or select newest unreflected batches / mark source consolidation), preventing infinite re-reflection on indices 0..9 and starvation past index 10.
2. Embed created reflection memories (belief, _b, _r) into VectorStore via _embedAndStoreVector / returned entry IDs; update the legacy string branch in routes/memories.py (lines 870-883) to run memory_dynamics.ensure_dynamics and stamp reflection_depth=1 + source_memory_ids.
3. Add 'closeness' to the allowed relationship dims in memory-manager.ts line 59 (matching engine/derive.py DIMS), resolve `relationship.who` via _resolve_person_name in routes/memories.py lines 956-986 instead of trusting arbitrary LLM strings, and avoid storing redundant identical `text: belief` on `_r` entries if already folded into `belief`.
4. Refine `_sanitizeTags` in memory-manager.ts (lines 139-160) so multi-word/unique proper names are stripped while common conceptual vocabulary words (e.g. fear, trust, key, fire) aren't wiped just because a graph item shares the noun.
sections.verify:
1. Run pytest tests for /memories/reflect verifying source-batch deduplication, legacy string reflection_depth=1 + ensure_dynamics, closeness updates in derive_person_profile, and rejection of unresolved relationship handles.
2. Run npm run build:ts and JS unit tests for AgentMemory.reflect candidate selection, embedding calls, and _sanitizeTags conceptual word preservation.

acceptance.text: AgentMemory.reflect() tracks reflected source_memory_ids / skips already-synthesized source sets and paginates beyond the first 10 candidates instead of repeating the same 10 memories every 5 turns.

Reflection outputs are embedded into VectorStore when configured, legacy string insights carry reflection_depth=1 and ensure_dynamics, and the reflection prompt exposes all 7 derive.py dimensions including 'closeness'.

/memories/reflect resolves relationship 'who' against known/resolvable world players instead of writing raw unvalidated rel:<who> tags, and _sanitizeTags avoids deleting legitimate concept tags (e.g. key, fear, fire) solely because an entity node happens to carry that word.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Character Inspector -> Mind -> Memories list & People profiles (static/js/inspector/mind-view.ts).

Current availability: Reactive mode invokes AgentMemory.reflect every 5 turns (agent-engine.ts lines 1436-1439), re-selecting the first 10 depth-0 memories repeatedly without marking them reflected or embedding the generated beliefs.

Manual verification steps:
1. Give a character 15 high-importance depth-0 memories and advance through two reflection cycles (10 turns).
   - expected: Cycle 2 reflects memories 11-15 instead of generating duplicate beliefs from memories 1-10.
2. Inspect created reflection memories and derived People profiles.
   - expected: Reflections carry valid VectorStore embeddings (when configured), support 'closeness' deltas, and only bind resolvable 'rel:<person>' identities.
